data.label: Synthetic sensor histories
data.description: Synthetic telemetry generator (existing caller, outside provisioning scope).

data.label: Synthetic maintenance records
data.description: Synthetic failure/repair history used as labels.

data.label: Telemetry ingestion
data.description: Kafka topics receive sensor readings; a consumer lands batches in Object Storage.

data.label: Raw and curated data
data.description: Private buckets for raw telemetry, maintenance records, feature sets and evaluation reports.

data.label: Feature preparation
data.description: Windowed sensor aggregates joined to failure labels with point-in-time correctness.

data.label: Training + held-out evaluation
data.description: Trains on earlier periods, evaluates on a later held-out time window; reports precision/recall and false alarms.

data.label: Versioned model
data.description: Stores model versions with training data reference and evaluation results; promotion is a manual approval.

data.label: Batch failure-risk scoring
data.description: Scores each asset's risk from latest features using the promoted model version.

data.label: Drift monitoring
data.description: Tracks input/prediction drift and quality against later labels; alerts trigger retraining review.

data.label: Work-order draft service
data.description: Builds draft work orders for high-risk assets with model version and reasons. Drafts only; never controls equipment.

data.label: Maintenance operator
data.description: Reviews, edits, approves or rejects drafts.

brief.application: Use IBM Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Predict equipment maintenance needs from synthetic sensor histories and maintenance records. Include ingestion, feature preparation, a versioned prediction model, held-out evaluation, drift monitoring and an operator work-order draft. No automatic equipment control. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.ibm-cloud-predictive-maintenance-end-to-end-sketch
decisions.title: IBM Cloud predictive maintenance end-to-end sketch
decisions.context: Scope: synthetic sensor histories and maintenance records → ingestion → features → time-split training/evaluation → versioned model → batch scoring → drift monitoring → operator-approved work-order draft. Assumptions: region not selected, IBM plans/model access unverified, no automatic equipment control. Design intent only; no native IBM generator for these ML components yet, so engineering is required.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Proposed: predictions only produce work-order drafts that an operator approves; the system never controls equipment.
needs.rationale: Prevents unsafe automated actions from a wrong prediction.
needs.basis: User: "No automatic equipment control" and "operator work-order draft".

needs.statement: Proposed: each model version is evaluated on a later held-out time window, and the results are stored with the version before it can be promoted.
needs.rationale: Random splits leak future information and overstate accuracy.
needs.basis: User: "a versioned prediction model, held-out evaluation".

needs.statement: Proposed: input and prediction drift are monitored, and alerts trigger a retraining review. Thresholds are still to be agreed.
needs.rationale: Sensor behaviour changes and quietly makes the model worse over time.
